name: Shindou Yuuka
source:
While working as a nun, she also works as an exorcist, exorcising demons just like Setsuna.

Like her gentle appearance, she has a calm personality, but she is a powerful exorcist and has exorcised numerous demons in the past.

Like Setsuna, she has suffered many hardships in her battles against demons, but she continues to fight for the sake of the people.

Recently, she has been active at a church near her new home.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.guilty-soft.com/product/Nightmare_x_Deathscythe/]official site[/url]]
